_comment: Source-owned policy for resolving the ASP.NET Core version represented by a merged pull request. The docs repository remains independent and always receives pull requests against main.

mainVersion.description: The ASP.NET Core version currently developed on the source repository's main branch. Update this once per yearly main-branch rollover.

releaseBranchPattern.description: Recognizes supported source release branches and extracts their ASP.NET Core version.

milestoneVersionPattern.description: Extracts a corroborating ASP.NET Core version from milestone titles such as 12.0 or 12.0-preview1.

docsMonikerPrefix.description: Builds Learn monikers such as aspnetcore-12.0 from the resolved source version.

docsBaseBranch.description: AspNetCore.Docs has no release branches; every generated documentation pull request targets main.
